name: Lemon Dijon Drumsticks, Roasted Mushrooms & Spinach-Artichoke Salad
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°F. Line a large baking sheet pan with aluminum foil to make clean up easier (optional).
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Peel and mince garlic; place in a large bowl.
Juice lemon into the bowl with the garlic, then add oil, Dijon, and spices; whisk to combine the marinade.
Add mushrooms to the bowl with the marinade.
Pat chicken dry with paper towels, add to the bowl, and toss to coat. Transfer mushrooms and drumsticks to the baking sheet, arranging them in an even layer; drizzle any leftover marinade over top.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, turning halfway through, until mushrooms and chicken are cooked through, 25-30 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, place mayo, oil, vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper in a medium bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
Drain and thinly slice artichokes; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Right before serving, add spinach to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide chicken, mushrooms, and salad between plates. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
